caseNameFull: Albemarle Paper Co. v. Moody and Halifax Local No. 425, United Papermakers & Paperworkers, AFL-CIO v. Moody

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 419 U. S. 1068.] Motion of petitioners for additional time for oral argument granted and ten additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondents allotted ten additional minutes for oral argument.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this motion.*
